correctness.rationale: Rebuilt the Ehrenfeucht–Fraisse/Hintikka rank3 signature: atomic diagrams of triples encode multiplication as ternary R and equality to named e. For a fixed ordered pair (x,y), a third quotient vector is either in their <=2-dimensional span or lies outside; for quotient dimension >=4 both square types occur outside span by nondegenerate quadratic-form fiber counts, allowing uniform finite extension profiles. Exhaustive four-dimensional plus/minus local tables give pointed profile counts e=4,c=4,I=7,J=8; the sole missing minus-type independent singular commuting pair duplicates the cx profile. Independently implemented exact group cocycle multiplication and computed full ordered triple signature sets for D8,Q8 and both order32 types, confirming exactly three rank3 theories and rank4 totally singular plane witness in plus32 only. Explicit rank2 and rank3 separating formulas distinguish the small groups. The finite test supports the all-rank local quadratic argument but is not the entire infinite proof.

A specialized older FO classification remains a material risk.
